				findRecId
				
    /// <summary>   
    /// Finds an excise register entry by its RecId.
    /// If _forUpdate is true, the record is locked for update.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="_recId">The RecId of the excise register entry.</param>
    /// <param name="_forUpdate">If true, locks the record for update.</param>
    /// <returns>The found METExciseRegisterEntry or null if not found.</returns> 
    public static METExciseRegisterEntry findRecId(RefRecId _recId, boolean _forUpdate = false)
    {
        METExciseRegisterEntry   exciseRegisterEntry = null;

        exciseRegisterEntry.selectForUpdate(_forUpdate);

        if (_recId)
        {
            select exciseRegisterEntry where exciseRegisterEntry.RecId == _recId;
        }

        return exciseRegisterEntry;
    }


			
			
				find
				
    /// <summary>
    /// Finds an excise register entry based on the provided lodgement, site ID, and item ID.
    /// If _forUpdate is true, the record is locked for update.
    /// This method is used to retrieve an existing excise register entry or create a new one if it does not exist.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name = "_lodgementExt">The METLodgementExt object representing the lodgement.</param>
    /// <param name = "_inventSiteId">The InventSiteId representing the site.</param>
    /// <param name = "_itemId">The ItemId representing the item.</param>
    /// <param name = "_forUpdate">If true, locks the record for update.</param>
    /// <returns>The found METExciseRegisterEntry or null if not found.</returns>
    public static METExciseRegisterEntry find(METLodgementExt _lodgementExt, InventSiteId _inventSiteId, ItemId _itemId, boolean _forUpdate = false)
    {
        METExciseRegisterEntry   exciseRegisterEntry = null;

        exciseRegisterEntry.selectForUpdate(_forUpdate);

        if (_lodgementExt && _inventSiteId && _itemId)
        {
            select exciseRegisterEntry where exciseRegisterEntry.Lodgement == _lodgementExt && exciseRegisterEntry.SiteId == _inventSiteId && exciseRegisterEntry.ItemId == _itemId;
        }

        return exciseRegisterEntry;
    }


			
			
				createExciseRegisterEntriyReceive
				
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates an excise register entry for the receiving site based on the transfer order lodgement.
    /// This method is called when a transfer order is received and an excise register entry needs to be created for the receiving site.
    /// It finds the existing excise register entry for the shipment site and creates a new one for the receiving site.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="_transferOrderLodgement">The METTransferOrderLodgements object representing the transfer order lodgement.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Error">Throws an error if the excise register entry for the shipment site does not exist or if the creation of the receiving site entry fails.</exception>
    /// <remarks>
    /// This method is used in scenarios where excise goods are transferred between sites, and it ensures that the excise register is updated correctly for both the shipment and receiving sites.
    /// It is particularly relevant for internal cross-dock transfers under bond, where the excise register must reflect the movement of goods.
    /// </remarks>
    public static void createExciseRegisterEntriyReceive(METTransferOrderLodgements _transferOrderLodgement)
    {
        // Find the exciseRegisterEntry for the shipment site based on the transfer order lodgement reference ID
        InventTransferJourLine inventTransferJourLine = InventTransferJourLine::findRecId(_transferOrderLodgement.ReferenceId);
        InventTransferJour InventTransferJour = InventTransferJour::find(inventTransferJourLine.TransferId, inventTransferJourLine.VoucherId);
        InventSiteId inventSiteIdFrom = InventLocation::find(InventTransferJour.InventLocationIdFrom).InventSiteId;
        METExciseRegisterEntry exciseRegisterEntryFrom = METExciseRegisterEntry::find(_transferOrderLodgement.Lodgement, inventSiteIdFrom, inventTransferJourLine.ItemId);

        // If the shipment exciseRegisterEntry does not exist, throw an error
        if (!exciseRegisterEntryFrom.RecId)
        {
            throw error(strFmt("@MET:LodgementNotExist", _transferOrderLodgement.Lodgement));
        }

        // Create a new excise register entry buffer for the receiving site based on the existing one from the shipping site
        METExciseRegisterEntry exciseRegisterEntryTo;
        buf2Buf(exciseRegisterEntryFrom, exciseRegisterEntryTo);
        exciseRegisterEntryTo.OriginType = InventTransType::TransferOrderReceive;
        exciseRegisterEntryTo.OriginDocumentNumber = inventTransferJourLine.TransferId;
        exciseRegisterEntryTo.SiteId = InventLocation::find(InventTransferJour.InventLocationIdTo).InventSiteId;
        
        // Create a new excise register entry for the receiving site
        METExciseRegisterEntry exciseRegisterEntryReceive = METExciseRegisterEntry::findOrCreate(exciseRegisterEntryTo);

        // Validate the creation of the excise register entry
        if (!exciseRegisterEntryReceive)
        {
            throw error(strFmt("@MET:FailedCreateExciseRegisterEntry", inventTransferJourLine.TransferId));
        }
    }


			
			
				shouldCreateExciseRegisterEntriyReceive
				
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks if an excise register entry should be created for the receiving site based on the transfer order line.
    /// This method is used to determine if an excise register entry needs to be created when receiving goods from a transfer order.
    /// It checks the transfer type, under bond status, auto receive setting, and update type of the transfer order.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="_inventTransferJourLine">The InventTransferJourLine object representing the transfer order line.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// Returns true if an excise register entry should be created for the receiving site, otherwise false.
    /// </returns>
    public static boolean shouldCreateExciseRegisterEntriyReceive(InventTransferJourLine _inventTransferJourLine)
    {
        InventTransferJour inventTransferJour = InventTransferJour::find(_inventTransferJourLine.TransferId, _inventTransferJourLine.VoucherId);
        METInventTransferTableExt inventTransferTableExt = inventTransferJour.inventTransferTable().metInventTransferTableExt();

        // Check if the transfer is an internal cross dock and under bond and auto receive is enabled and the update type is shipment
        return inventTransferTableExt.UnderBond == NoYes::Yes &&
               inventTransferTableExt.TransferType == METCrossDockTransferType::CrossDock &&
               inventTransferJour.AutoReceiveQty == NoYes::Yes &&
               inventTransferJour.UpdateType == InventTransferUpdateType::Shipment;
    }
